caption:
You wait for their approval to feel you count. But some standing isn't granted by the room — it's given by the One who sent you. (Galatians 1:17-19 devotional)

You wait for the right people to nod before you believe you truly belong. But Paul deliberately didn't run to Jerusalem for approval — an ambassador's authority is the letter that sent him, not the welcome he receives. Your worth isn't voted on by the room; it was sealed by the One who sent you, and even strangers glorified God because the One who changed Paul was God.
